So, supporting family members is important. Graduation is a significant milestone. It's a time of celebration and recognition of hard work. So, considering all this, it seems like going to the sister's graduation would be the right thing to do from a Christian perspective. It's about showing love, support, and fulfilling family responsibilities as taught in the Bible.
